An AGENT revision applied from the banner returns exactly 'RESOLVED=11 / ACTION=apply_now / REVN=21' with no branch, on either the CLI or the banner. That asymmetry is the finding; the rival cannot explain why the save path bothers.
evidence: Applied pending #11 while viewing CHECKOUT_REVN=18; it landed at revn 21 on alt-0019 with base 20. Response named neither. DOWNGRADED FROM P2 — see the retraction: status DID report HEAD=alt-0019, the agent warned me in plain words, and a branch switch exists in the UI. The residue is one missing field on one response.

title: the apply response never names the branch it landed on, though the UI's save toast does

discriminator: The client does not clip: the cold observer, with no context, reported the heads 'pierce the box and stop inside it, with their heads sitting on the interior next to (and nearly touching) the words Risk model -> Aggregate'. evidence: m-downstream box x 1560-1780, y 480-576. a-tech-down end (1615,536) INSIDE. a-emb-down end (1670,536) INSIDE. a-port-down end (1725,536) INSIDE. title: an arrow that terminates deep INSIDE its bound box passes the detached-endpoint check, which only tests the far side

discriminator: Separate the registry as a RECORD from VIEW_DEBT as an ACTIONABLE PROMPT. The rival holds for the former and fails for the latter. On branch alt-0019 the registry says concept 'argus' owns views ['daily-run-flow','argus-one-page','argus-domain'] with owed: [], and status prints VIEW_DEBT=none — so the agent, drawing onto this branch, is told it owes no domain view while the branch has none. The debt mechanism exists to nag the agent into drawing; here it is branch-blind in the direction that SUPPRESSES work. The only thing that noticed was a failed export: ERROR=unknown artifact 'argus-domain' (known: admin-console, argus-one-page, daily-run-flow, enrichment-mechanics, risk-deep-dive, source-failure-modes, weekly-brief).
evidence: FOUND BY THE AGENT, unprompted, during the handover export — the first found-by agent of the run. Its words: 'the domain model is not on the branch you're working on... argus-domain landed on main and never came across. So the single artifact you called the best thing drawn is the one artifact I couldn't export.' Verified: status ARTIFACTS omits argus-domain, artifacts/ on disk has 7 files without it, export errors, and model.json still lists it under concept argus with owed: []. Registry loads artifact_meta from the files present (canvas.py:5408) but concept.views is never reconciled against them.
rival: correct by design — the fork was taken from revn 13, before the domain model existed, so its absence is right, and the registry is a project-level record rather than a branch-level one
title: the registry is global while scenes are per-branch, so on a branch it asserts views that do not exist and marks their debt paid
